label: Front three-quarter · Tesla studio
note: The front and rear wheel centers register with the studio view. The hood crown and lower headlamp reflectors carry a softer highlight than Tesla’s render.

label: Driver side · Tesla studio
note: The liftback, rocker and four-door glasshouse follow the profile. The model carries a slightly higher roof arc through the front half.

label: Rear three-quarter · Tesla studio
note: The rear shoulder, tapered quarter window and black valance track the source. The inner taillight guide and spoiler edge have less depth.

label: Front three-quarter · owner photograph
note: The owner photograph checks the nose, hood and glasshouse on a real 2023 car. The far front wheel, roof crown and round shoulder show the largest apparent displacement.

label: Front elevation · owner photograph
note: The width of the bumper and the mirror tips follow the head-on photograph. The source sits in deep ground shadow. The windshield shoulders and lower tire edges remain less certain.

label: Passenger side · owner photograph
note: The passenger side independently checks wheel spacing, door length and the slope of the hatch. Reflections make the lower bumper edges difficult to trace.

label: Rear three-quarter · owner photograph
note: The rear door, tailgate and stepped bumper follow the oblique rear view. Lens detail, the plate recess and gloss vary visibly.

label: Rear elevation · owner photograph
note: The rear graphic and center glass can be inspected head-on. The registration plate and lit brake lamps belong to the reference vehicle.

label: Front three-quarter · dealer photograph
note: This second 2023 car cross-checks hood and front bumper curvature. Its wheel covers have been removed.

label: 19-inch Gemini · Tesla studio
note: The seven silver vanes, dark returns and center cap follow the studio close-up. The cover dish, tread relief and sidewall lettering are simplified.

label: Front cabin · Tesla studio
note: The freestanding display, single horizontal vent, wood trim and center console are visible in both views. The virtual camera and upholstery contours are approximate.

label: Steering wheel and dash · owner photograph
note: The three-spoke steering wheel, scrollers and landscape display follow the owner photograph. The screen illustration is original, and the trim and seats remain coarser.

label: Second row · owner photograph
note: The headrests, shoulder bolsters and split backrest distinguish the second row. This reference car has seven seats. The modeled configuration has five.
